cards.headline: The Factory Tests. What Does the Brand Do?
body: Domestic Korean OEM: the brand receives and manages test results.

sourceTrace.heading: 공장이 맡는 품질검사와 브랜드 회사에 남는 일

cards.headline: Separate the Factory and Brand Roles

body.text: Tests raw materials, packaging and finished products, and writes and retains manufacturing and quality records.
The responsible distributor oversees the contractor and receives and manages batch-specific results and related records.

sourceTrace.heading: 공장이 맡는 품질검사와 브랜드 회사에 남는 일

cards.takeaway: Sharing costs by contract does not change who owes the statutory duties.

cards.headline: When a Separate Test May Be Omitted

body.text: The manufacturer and responsible distributor are the same business.
For separate businesses: entrust testing to a legally eligible facility AND have batch-specific results.

sourceTrace.heading: 그렇다면 같은 제품을 두 번 검사해야 할까요?

cards.takeaway: Oversight, record management and final-product quality duties remain.

cards.headline: These Duties Remain After Outsourcing

body.text: A responsible distributor outsourcing manufacture or specified testing must oversee the contractor.
Receive, retain and manage manufacturing and quality-control records.
Maintain quality control of the final product.

sourceTrace.heading: 그렇다면 같은 제품을 두 번 검사해야 할까요?

cards.takeaway: Omitting a separate test does not remove these duties.

cards.headline: Agree on How Test Records Reach You
body: Identify the tester and how to match results to the batches being delivered.
Agree who sends and reviews required product standards and quality-control records, and when.
Retain the records under the company's quality rules.

sourceTrace.heading: ‘검사 완료’라는 메일과 납품 상자의 번호가 맞지 않는다면

cards.takeaway: “Test complete” alone may not identify which batch was tested.

cards.headline: What If the Approved Specification Changes?

body.text: Identify the approved sample, product specifications, container, packaging and necessary test standards.
For changes that may affect quality, you may agree on advance notice and records, then written confirmation of the change and effective date.

sourceTrace.heading: 샘플을 승인한 다음 제품 사양이 달라진다면

cards.takeaway: Agree on notice, approval and internal review. Further testing depends on the change.

cards.headline: Share What Quality Control Requires

body.text: The manufacturer must give the distributor necessary information from manufacturing and quality records.
If manufacturer and responsible distributor are the same business, submission may be omitted.

cards.takeaway: Cosmetics Act Enforcement Rule, Article 11(1)6: submission duty and exceptions.

cards.headline: Trade Secrets: All Three Conditions Apply

body.text: The manufacturer designs, develops AND produces the product.
The omission must stay within a scope that does not affect quality or safety management.
The information must qualify as a trade secret under the contract between both parties.

cards.takeaway: Omission is permitted only within that scope. “Trade secret” alone gives no blanket exemption.

cards.headline: Compare the Three Documents Before Signing
body: Approved sample and product, container and packaging specifications
Tester and legal conditions for outsourced testing
Delivery timing for batch results and required records
Contacts for changes, nonconforming results and post-sale inquiries and record support

sourceTrace.heading: 다시 첫 견적서를 펼쳐보면 무엇이 달라질까요?

cards.takeaway: Check for consistent roles and record flow across the quotation, contract and quality rules.

cards.headline: Start with the Documents You Have

body.text: Send the quotation or draft contract, test-record guidance or quality rules you already hold.
Ethos Administrative Attorney Office checks the tester, batch-result delivery, owners named in the contract and quality rules, and terms still to agree.

sourceTrace.heading: 직접 준비할 수 있는 부분과 맡길 수 있는 문서 작업

cards.takeaway: Drafting contracts and related documents is a paid service with scope and fees agreed separately.

editorialReview.reviewNote: 별도 미승인 비교 초안. 원본 Source Lock 보존. 독립 법률 검토 및 실제 국영 렌더 검토 완료. 법정 설계·개발·생산 누적조건과 체크리스트의 가운뎃점은 의미·스캔 가독성을 위해 유지. 의무·재량 종결은 어미 비율 때문에 변경하지 않음. 승인·발행 아님.
